knowledge:
- key_parameters: coords=A numeric vector (e.g., c(-500, 500)) defining the x-axis coordinates relative to the center of the genomic windows ;; label=An optional text label displayed in the top left-hand corner of the plot ;; color=A color palette name (e.g., from RColorBrewer) or a vector of colors to interpolate, or a list of colors when plotting multiple groups ;; output.size=A numeric vector c(width, height) specifying the dimensions of the output image matrix for smoothing ;; algorithm=The smoothing method, either "kernel" (for binary data) or "blur" (for continuous data) ;; groups=A factor or numeric vector to group related plots for normalizing scales and display settings in plotHeatmapList ;; partition=A numeric vector specifying the size of each partition/cluster to display partition lines and legends
- alternatives: The documentation does not mention alternative heatmap packages, but relies on core Bioconductor packages like GenomicRanges (for window generation and trimming), rtracklayer (for importing BED files), and BSgenome (for sequence extraction) to prepare inputs.
- when_to_use: Use when you want to visualize genome-wide signals (e.g., ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, DNase-seq coverage) or sequence features (e.g., k-mer frequency, PWM match scores) centered around specific genomic intervals (like promoters or peaks) in a highly customizable, publication-ready heatmap format.
- pitfalls: Out-of-bound ranges must be trimmed and filtered (e.g., using trim() and checking width()) to avoid errors when generating windows near chromosome ends ;; Raw pattern heatmaps (e.g., k-mers) are binary and sparse, making them difficult to visualize without smoothing via smoothHeatmap ;; In plotHeatmapList, passing a vector of colors (e.g., c("red", "white", "blue")) interpolates them for a single heatmap, whereas passing a list (e.g., list("Blues", "Spectral")) applies different color palettes to different groups of heatmaps ;; Plotting high-resolution unsmoothed heatmaps to PDF can result in massive file sizes; PNG with high resolution (res="150") and real-world units is recommended instead.

workflows.name: genomic_coverage_heatmaps
workflows.intent: Plot heatmaps and meta-region profiles of functional genomics coverage data (e.g., ChIP-seq) over genomic windows, with optional row clustering.
input: genomic_intervals.bed (BED file containing genomic regions of interest)
coverage_data.rds (RDS file containing RleList of genome-wide coverage data)
workflows.stages: 1. Import genomic intervals and define centered genomic windows, trimming out-of-bound ranges. ;; 2. Load coverage data. ;; 3. Create a heatmap object using CoverageHeatmap. ;; 4. Plot the heatmap using plotHeatmapList or meta-region plot using plotHeatmapMeta. ;; 5. (Optional) Extract the raw matrix, cluster rows using kmeans, and plot the partitioned heatmap.
workflows.code:
zf_30p_promoters = import(heatmaps_file("30pEpi_proms.bed"), genome=seqinfo(Drerio))

h3k4me3_30p_pos = readRDS(heatmaps_file("H3K4me3_30p_pos.rds"))
h3k4me3_30p_neg = readRDS(heatmaps_file("H3K4me3_30p_neg.rds"))
h3k4me3_30p = h3k4me3_30p_pos + h3k4me3_30p_neg

coords=c(-500, 500)

windows_30p = promoters(zf_30p_promoters, -coords[1], coords[2])
windows_30p = windows_30p[width(trim(windows_30p)) == 1000]
h3k4me3_30p_heatmap = CoverageHeatmap(
    windows_30p,
    h3k4me3_30p,
    coords=coords,
    label="H3K4me3 30p")

plotHeatmapList(h3k4me3_30p_heatmap, cex.label=1, color="Greens")

plotHeatmapMeta(h3k4me3_30p_heatmap)

h3k4me3_30p_subtracted = h3k4me3_30p_pos - h3k4me3_30p_neg

h3k4me3_30p_subtracted_hm = CoverageHeatmap(
    windows_30p,
    h3k4me3_30p_subtracted,
    coords=coords,
    label="Phase")

scale(h3k4me3_30p_subtracted_hm) = c(-150, 150)

plotHeatmapList(h3k4me3_30p_subtracted_hm, cex.label=1.5, color=c("red", "white", "blue"), legend=TRUE, legend.width=0.3)

raw_matrix = image(h3k4me3_30p_subtracted_hm)
clusters = kmeans(raw_matrix, 2)$cluster

mat = raw_matrix[order(clusters),]

h3k4me3_30p_subtracted_kmeans = Heatmap(
  mat,
  coords=coords,
  label="kmeans",
  scale=c(-150, 150))

plotHeatmapList(h3k4me3_30p_subtracted_kmeans,
                cex.label=1.5,
                color=c("red", "white", "blue"),
                partition=c(sum(clusters==1), sum(clusters==2)),
                partition.legend=TRUE,
                partition.lines=TRUE,
                legend=TRUE,
                legend.pos="r",
                legend.width=0.3)

workflows.name: sequence_feature_heatmaps
workflows.intent: Plot heatmaps of sequence features (k-mer occurrences or PWM match scores) across genomic windows, applying smoothing to handle data sparsity.
input: genomic_intervals.bed (BED file containing genomic regions of interest)
pwm_matrix (Position Weight Matrix for motif scanning)
workflows.stages: 1. Import genomic intervals and define centered genomic windows. ;; 2. Extract DNA sequences using getSeq. ;; 3. Generate pattern heatmaps for k-mers or PWMs using PatternHeatmap or PWMScanHeatmap. ;; 4. Smooth the sparse/binary heatmap using smoothHeatmap. ;; 5. Plot individual or grouped heatmaps using plotHeatmapList.
workflows.code:
seq_30p = getSeq(Drerio, windows_30p)

ta_30p = PatternHeatmap(seq_30p, "TA", coords=coords)
plotHeatmapList(ta_30p)

ta_30p_smoothed = smoothHeatmap(ta_30p, output.size=c(250, 500), algorithm="kernel")
plotHeatmapList(ta_30p_smoothed)

example_data = new.env()
data(HeatmapExamples, envir=example_data)
tata_pwm = get("tata_pwm", example_data)

tata_pwm_30p = PatternHeatmap(seq_30p, tata_pwm, coords=coords, label="TATA", min.score="60%")
plotHeatmapList(smoothHeatmap(tata_pwm_30p, output.size=c(250, 500)))

tata_pwm_scan_30p = PWMScanHeatmap(seq_30p, tata_pwm, coords=coords, label="TATA")
tata_pwm_scan_30p_smoothed = smoothHeatmap(tata_pwm_scan_30p, algorithm="blur", output.size=c(250, 500))
scale(tata_pwm_scan_30p_smoothed) = c(40, 60)
plotHeatmapList(tata_pwm_scan_30p_smoothed, color="Spectral", legend=TRUE, legend.width=0.3)

cg_30p = PatternHeatmap(seq_30p, "CG", coords=coords)
cg_30p_smoothed = smoothHeatmap(cg_30p, output.size=c(250, 500))

hm_list = list(
    ta_30p_smoothed,
    cg_30p_smoothed,
    tata_pwm_scan_30p_smoothed,
    smoothHeatmap(h3k4me3_30p_heatmap, output.size=c(250, 500))
)

plotHeatmapList(hm_list,
                groups=c(1, 1, 2, 3),
                color=list("Blues", "Spectral", "Greens"),
                cex.label=list(2, 2, 1.25))
